notes: Curated checks for discovery-rubric-auditor. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested; score focused revisions on the affected decisions and retained constraints. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: Please audit a sample of discovery calls with one consistent rubric and turn portfolio-level patterns into manager-ready coaching priorities.
Please compare discovery quality across calls or reps, find recurring gaps, or establish a cohort or team baseline.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable discovery rubric audit and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please design an adaptive discovery guide and outcome-led demo flow for a defined buyer, segment, stage, and meeting type.
Please review one sales call and turn recording, transcript, or notes evidence into clear coaching priorities and next-practice actions.
Please create role-based readiness certifications with evidence requirements, defensible pass/fail standards, behaviorally anchored scoring, and assessor calibration.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-rubric-auditor-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Names audit scope and sample shape: counts by comparable unit, exclusions, coverage, and skew.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-rubric-auditor-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Records calibration status, including single-reviewer limits or inter-rater reliability: not established.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-rubric-auditor-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Reports de-identified results with distributions and a denominator on every aggregate.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-rubric-auditor-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Separates recurring patterns from one-offs and recommends coaching, practice, process repair, or further investigation according to the evidence.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-rubric-auditor-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Keeps thin or mixed samples directional, does not rank reps from unlike calls, and does not issue a pass/fail.

output_structure_checks.name: discovery-rubric-auditor-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Tests whether the recommended intervention addresses the observed gap and defines comparable follow-up evidence rather than assuming another training session is needed.
